name: chisel
title: Chisel
description: A letter-cutter's portfolio on Welsh slate (Portland stone by day) whose every title is a cut inscription — centred, wide-spaced capitals between white-pencil setting-out lines — with the work listed down one arched tablet and services parted by mid-dots.

tokens.--font-caps: flared capitals for every inscription, the name in the header, the menu, services, labels and the roll of work
tokens.--font-text: old-style serif for everything read at length: the opening lines, descriptions, years, clients and page text
tokens.--font-mono: typeface for code in page text
tokens.--text-s: size of the small capitals — menu, services, labels, the roll of work, pagination and footer
tokens.--text-m: size of body text and of the name in the header
tokens.--text-l: size of the italic opening sentence under a page title, and of third-level headings in page text
tokens.--text-inscription: size of page titles — the main inscription on each tablet
tokens.--text-inscription-s: size of project and post titles cut on the tablet of a list
tokens.--leading-text: line height of body text and services
tokens.--leading-inscription: line height of inscriptions — also the spacing of the setting-out lines, which repeat once per line
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter-spacing of inscriptions and the roll heading
tokens.--guide-top: where the upper setting-out line falls in each inscription line, measured from the top of the line (the height of the capitals)
tokens.--guide-base: where the lower setting-out line falls in each inscription line — the line the capitals stand on
tokens.--color-bg: page background — the slate (Portland stone by day)
tokens.--color-text: inscriptions, body text and links — the cut (or painted) letter
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text — menu, services, years and clients, labels — and the lozenge stops between pieces of work
tokens.--color-guide: the setting-out lines ruled through every inscription, and the rule beside a quotation
tokens.--color-tablet: face of the tablets that carry the titles and the list of work
tokens.--color-edge: the cut margin line inside each tablet, and the rules above the particulars, the roll of work and table rows
tokens.--color-cut: the shadow along the top edge of each cut letter (clear by day, when the letters are painted)
tokens.--color-code-bg: panel behind code in page text
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text, the roll of work and the footer
tokens.--tablet-width: width of the tablets and of the header above them
tokens.--tablet-arch: rise of the segmental head of each tablet
tokens.--space-1: spacing scale — hairline: between footer lines and nested list items
tokens.--space-2: spacing scale — tight: between a title and its services, year and description
tokens.--space-3: spacing scale — base: the page margin and the gap between paragraphs
tokens.--space-4: spacing scale — roomy: between one piece of work and the next
tokens.--space-5: spacing scale — section: above page text, the roll of work and the footer, and below the last piece of work
